statements.proposition: Users encountered a desktop-composition error when connecting via RDP (problem background).
statements.note: Describes the reported issue that motivated the change (class 5/1), not something the author did, ran or verified in this change.
evidence: Message section '## Problem' precedes '## Solution'; text is a description of the user-reported error from issue #1010

statements.proposition: Microsoft documentation says desktop composition is always enabled since Windows 8.
statements.note: A statement about an external document, not an action in this change.
evidence: Span begins 'According to [Microsoft documentation](...)'; it attributes a fact to an external source

statements.proposition: This change adds a comment referencing the Microsoft documentation in the modified code.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Comment added in each of the three listed files (the bullet is repeated under AxMsRdpClient09Host.xaml.cs, RDP.cs, RdpConfig.cs).
evidence: gh api pulls/1011/files patch of Ui/Model/Protocol/RDP.cs adds '// ref: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/dwm/wm-dwmcompositionchanged'
patch of Ui/Utils/RdpFile/RdpConfig.cs adds an XML doc comment with the same ref URL
patch of Ui/View/Host/ProtocolHosts/AxMsRdpClient09Host.xaml.cs adds the same ref comment

statements.proposition: The change makes the application's desktop-composition behavior consistent with Windows 8+ (composition always on, never disabled).
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: The diff does show composition now always requested (AllowDesktopComposition=1 for all modes, default 1, flag 0x100 always set), so the code side matches the sentence. But 'aligns with Windows 8+ requirements' and that this prevents the HRESULT error cannot be settled without running on Windows; also the sentence is interpretive, so no concrete check settles it.
evidence: RDP.cs patch: AllowDesktopComposition = 1 set before the switch; per-case assignments removed (Low's 0 removed)
RdpConfig.cs patch: default changed from 0 to 1
AxMsRdpClient09Host.xaml.cs patch: 0x00000100 flag always added; no Windows environment available to verify runtime behavior
